item.title: Expected · Mission Bay South Block 12 West: OCII Commission scheduled to consider… (Oct 6, 2026)
item.description: OCII Commission scheduled to consider authorizing the Block 12 West MOU with FOCIL-MB (about 265 affordable and 270 market-rate units; Resolution No. 23-2026) at its October 6, 2026 meeting. The August 13, 2026 CAC deck had targeted September 2026; the item was not on the September 1 agenda and the September 15 meeting was cancelled. The outcome of the October 6 meeting is not confirmed in any source written after it (see open questions). (Oct 6, 2026). Source: OCII (primary city agency document), 2026-10-06; OCII (primary city agency document), 2026-09; OCII (primary city agency document, presented to the Mission Bay CAC), 2026-08-13; OCII (primary city agency document), 2026-10-06.

item.title: Added · 409/499 Illinois Street: Caffe Central (490 Illinois St; SF YIMBY, 2020-11-27, places…
item.description: Caffe Central (490 Illinois St; SF YIMBY, 2020-11-27, places UCSF's Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision at 490 Illinois Street) had been missing and was added, confirmed via the cafe's own site, which publishes this exact address as a location. No opening date found (SF YIMBY reported the building open by Nov 27, 2020, so the cafe can't predate that). It is assigned to the 490-499 Illinois St record, whose sourced address is 490 Illinois St, not the neighboring UCSF Valley Center for Vision (west) record, a separate building about 60-100 m away across the street with an unresolved naming question. DataSF business registrations show no listing for Caffe Central at this address (only one at 460 16th St, presumably a different location of the same small chain), so, like Standard Deviant Brewing, it was a real tenant missing from the registration data. Source: https://www.caffecentral.com/490-illinois-street-mission-bay.
item.source: https://www.caffecentral.com/490-illinois-street-mission-bay

item.title: Expected · 409/499 Illinois Street: Early construction work is under way and the main… (~2026)
item.description: Early construction work is under way and the main renovation of 409 Illinois St is expected to begin in 2026: 261,117 gross sq ft to be converted into a new home for UCSF's School of Dentistry and a shared education center for students in dentistry, medicine, nursing, pharmacy and physical therapy (UC's project title: Mission Bay Education Center and Dental Clinics). American School & University (2026-09-08) says "renovation work expected to begin in 2026" and "Early construction activities are underway" while final design is completed; Suffolk (contractor) and CO Architects (architect) were selected via progressive design-build (Construction Dive, published September 1, 2026, citing an August 27 announcement). No source read dates the start of the main renovation. This milestone is expected, not confirmed, and is for 409 Illinois St only: the record's status (complete) rests on the 2008 completion of 499 and the 2009 permit closure, not on this renovation. (~2026). Source: American School & University, 2026-09-08; Construction Dive, 2026-09-01.
item.source: American School & University, 2026-09-08; Construction Dive, 2026-09-01

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay South Block 4 East: A CEQA Notice of Exemption is filed for… (Apr 14, 2026)
item.description: A CEQA Notice of Exemption is filed for the Block 4-East project (statutory exemption under AB 1449 / Public Resources Code section 21080.40, the 100%-affordable-housing exemption). The notice states that all residential units "will be dedicated to lower-income households (earning no more than 70% of Area Median Income" on a HUD and TCAC basis, excluding unrestricted manager units, and that the project "is subject to recorded TCAC Regulatory Agreements prior to the issuance of building permits" (future tense: the agreements are to be recorded). Resolution No. 02-2026 gives two manager's units in each phase. (Apr 14, 2026). Source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2026-04-14.
item.source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2026-04-14
